neighbours.label: A later (non-first) parameter or loop-variable identifier in Python code, at the point it is introduced: def f(self, node, |prefix|), (items, item, |key|=None), for |section| in …; generic names such as name, key, type, prefix

notes: Probes were moderate (0.25-0.42) and peaked on the last parameter of a signature ('prefix', 'name', 'key', also 'seconds'); a lone short signature scored 0.02-0.15. Not specific to the words name/key.
